listing.name: Spider-Man — OpenSpideyPS1 (GTTeancum)
listing.summary: Both games are reported to reach gameplay. Complete playthroughs and long sessions have explicitly not been tested. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA BIN/CUE or ISO for the selected game. This guide does not specify the exact supported serial number or revision; check that game’s project requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use this game’s v1.0 runtime ZIP and extract your own disc during setup. The package uses the shared C# runtime.
